name: Data Pipelines
description: Ingest, validate, transform and output arbitrary datasets via configurable source/pipeline/destination (ETL).
project_description: Data Pipelines provides an ETL framework built around a 'dataset' content entity. Each dataset pairs a source plugin (CSV or JSON drawn from an uploaded file, a remote URL, or pasted text) with a code-defined pipeline of validation and transform plugins, and one or more configured destinations (a JSON or CSV file by default; contributed sub-projects add Elasticsearch, OpenSearch and SFTP). Content editors add and manage datasets at /admin/content/datasets; developers declare pipelines in a {module}.data_pipelines.yml file. Processing is deferred to the Batch and Queue APIs so large datasets can be validated and written to destinations outside the normal save request.
